comments.author: System ADMIN
comments.content: Welcome! We are currently discussing whether our baseline definition for the Bullwhip Effect fully captures all relevant drivers. Open questions for discussion: * Should we explicitly mention inventory management policies alongside forecasting updates?   * Would it be more accurate to refine "demand distortions" into "distortions in the perception of demand"?   What is your perspective? Feel free to reply below or propose an update to the definition!

comments.author: System ADMIN
comments.content:
We are reviewing the definition of Capacity within the semiconductor domain. Key feedback under review:

Time & Product Mix: Should capacity explicitly specify a timeframe (e.g., over a given duration) and account for the technology/product mix?

Scope & Separation: Should the dispatching/lot priority rules be separated from the core definition of capacity?

What is your perspective? Reply below to share your feedback before the consensus vote is finalized!
